session_completed_fields.name: session_completed_fields
session_completed_fields.value: ("campaign_sessions"."status" = 'COMPLETED') = ("campaign_sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "campaign_sessions"."ending_type" IS NOT NULL)

rolls_public_sequence_visibility.name: rolls_public_sequence_visibility
rolls_public_sequence_visibility.value: ("blue_rose_dice_rolls"."visibility" = 'GM_ONLY' AND "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."public_sequence" IS NULL) OR ("blue_rose_dice_rolls"."visibility" <> 'GM_ONLY' AND "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."public_sequence" > 0 AND "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."public_sequence" IS NOT NULL)

roll_faces_valid.name: roll_faces_valid
roll_faces_valid.value: "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."die1" BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."die2" BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."drama_die" BETWEEN 1 AND 6

roll_sp_valid.name: roll_sp_valid
roll_sp_valid.value: "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."stunt_points" BETWEEN 0 AND 6 AND ("blue_rose_dice_rolls"."stunt_points" = 0 OR ("blue_rose_dice_rolls"."success" AND "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."stunt_points" = "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."drama_die" AND ("blue_rose_dice_rolls"."die1" = "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."die2" OR "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."die1" = "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."drama_die" OR "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."die2" = "blue_rose_dice_rolls"."drama_die")))

events_public_sequence_visibility.name: events_public_sequence_visibility
events_public_sequence_visibility.value: ("game_events"."visibility" = 'GM_ONLY' AND "game_events"."public_sequence" IS NULL) OR ("game_events"."visibility" <> 'GM_ONLY' AND "game_events"."public_sequence" > 0 AND "game_events"."public_sequence" IS NOT NULL)
